_comment: One NMOS and one PMOS row cell (an inverter), each in a row of its own: the single-device test of the stems cells in every PDK and tool. Netlists (per PDK): hand-written, pdk/<pdk>/layout/netlists/mos_inv.sp (in each PDK's submodule). Groups: ALIGN's primitives (its library's names), as ALIGN's 1_topology groups the netlist without a floorplan.
